## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue (or noted "none" for a trivial fix)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behavior changes and bug fixes
- [ ] `bun run check`, `bun run build`, and `bun run test` all pass locally
- [ ] `lib/` rebuilt and committed alongside source changes (**never** hand-edit `lib/`)
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) `[Unreleased]` entry added (user-visible changes)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Docs updated (README, CONTRIBUTING, tool tables) when behavior changed
